clips.title: The story
paras: The Rotting Orchard is a blighted, abandoned fruit grove situated in southern Duskwood. Once a source of harvest for the nearby settlement of Darkshire, it has fallen into ruin and is now overrun by ravenous lupine predators known as the Nightbane pack.

Located east of the ruined Yorgen Farmstead and west of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, the Rotting Orchard stands as a grim testament to Duskwood's decline. The trees hang heavy with withered, spoiled fruit, while dilapidated barns and outbuildings have been converted into rough encampments by the Nightbane worgen. Nightbane Stalkers prowl the twisted brush, while dark casters known as Shadow Weavers weave their sinister magic amid the decaying timber. The pack answers to the fierce worgen Gutspill and Nefaru, who lair in the nearby mine of Roland's Doom.
